verdict.rationale: HeyGen's enterprise API page lists "zero data retention options" among its enterprise features, so the product itself offers some retention control. The evidence is a single marketing line tied to the enterprise tier, with no detail on how retention is configured. Nothing in the pack shows user-initiated deletion of videos, avatars or uploaded data, through the UI or the API. Missing for 10: documented deletion endpoints or controls, configurable retention periods, availability outside the enterprise tier, in-depth first-party docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
